subject: SOW invoicing cadence & PO onboarding - next steps
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@atlasprocurement.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: tim.jones@atlas-retail.com
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO format + invoice cadence for Redwood SOW

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for sending over the SOW. We're ready to raise a PO but need to confirm a couple of procurement requirements before we submit:

- Invoice cadence: Atlas standard is monthly invoices summarizing actual usage, with net-45 payment terms. Is Redwood able to support monthly invoices with line-item token usage aggregated by project?
- PO details: Our template includes a single PO number per service line and a billing address (see attached PO template). Can you confirm Redwood's remit address and vendor legal name for the PO?
- Required docs: we need a completed W-9 (US vendor) and the signed SOW attached to the PO.

Also, are there any prepayment or deposit requirements if we request net-45? Our legal prefers explicit contract language about rate lock and overage billing cadence.

Appreciate a quick confirmation; procurement would like to issue the PO this week.

Best,
Marta Alvarez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Atlas Retail Group

Attachment: Atlas_PO_Template.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet - fields: PO#, service line, billing address)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@atlasprocurement.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO format + invoice cadence for Redwood SOW

Hi Marta —

Thanks — happy to confirm the details so procurement can move forward. Quick answers below and a couple of asks so we line up with finance: 

- Invoice cadence: We can do monthly invoices that summarize token usage by project/service line. Invoices will include line-item token counts, unit pricing, and any overage charges.
- Net terms: Our standard is net-30. We can support net-45 for enterprise customers on negotiated contracts; for net-45 we typically require either (a) a signed PO referencing the SOW and vendor legal name exactly, or (b) a 25% deposit applied to the first invoice. Which would you prefer?
- PO format / vendor info: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Remit: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  575 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
  Tax ID/EIN: 12-3456789 (I will attach the W-9).

I attached the latest SOW (Redwood_SOW-v2.pdf) and our W-9 for the PO. Rafael — looping you in for any finance constraints on net-45 exceptions.

If procurement can confirm they will reference the SOW ID (RDW-2026-4981) on the PO, we can accept net-45 without a deposit. Otherwise, we'll need the 25% first-invoice deposit.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-v2.pdf; W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@atlasprocurement.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO format + invoice cadence for Redwood SOW

Hi Marta and Vanessa —

Finance here. Short confirmation from our side: we can agree to net-45 for Atlas on the condition that the PO includes the following clause verbatim in the PO notes section: 

"Payment terms: Net 45 from receipt of invoice. Invoice shall reference SOW RDW-2026-4981. Any disputed amounts must be raised within 30 days of invoice date. Charges are billed in USD."

If the PO references the SOW ID exactly as above, we waive the 25% deposit requirement. If Atlas cannot include that language, we will need a deposit equal to 25% of the first invoice (credit applied to the first billed month).

Also confirm: invoices should be emailed to accounting@atlas-retail.com and cc: ar@redwood.com. PDF invoices are preferred.

I'll also flag that for pilot workloads we often set an initial not-to-exceed cap on monthly spend for the first 90 days to avoid surprises — happy to add that to the SOW amendment if that's helpful.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa and Rafael — that works. Procurement will issue the PO with the exact PO notes clause you specified and will reference SOW RDW-2026-4981. We will use monthly invoicing with net-45 payment terms.

A couple follow-ups: 
- Please confirm the remit address is the San Francisco address you provided (for our vendor master).
- We will attach the signed SOW to the PO.
- We will send the PO to vendor.master@atlasprocurement.com and include your accounting@redwood.com address.

Tim (cc'd) is our finance ops lead and will process the PO. Expect a PDF of the PO by end of day.

Regards,
Marta
